Name: Mr. Piyush Shaha
Bio: Mr. Piyush Shaha is an accomplished academician with extensive experience in the fields of Statistics, Operations Management, and Business Administration. He holds multiple postgraduate degrees, including an M.Sc. in Statistics, M.B.A. in Operations, and M.Com. in Business Administration, along with a B.Sc. in Statistics. He has also qualified the SET (State Eligibility Test) in Mathematical Sciences and is currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Statistics. Mr. Shaha has been serving as an Assistant Professor at MIT-WPU since January 2024. Prior to this, he held key academic positions at several reputed institutions, including NMIMS University, St. John College of Humanities and Science, The New College – Kolhapur, and others. His teaching career spans over 15 years, covering diverse roles such as full-time faculty, visiting professor, academic coordinator, and secondary school mathematics teacher. He began his academic journey as a Visiting Professor (CHB) in 2005, and since then, has consistently contributed to higher education through teaching, academic administration, and assessment roles. Mr. Shaha has served as an invigilator, moderator, and paper setter across various reputed institutions affiliated to Shivaji University, Mumbai University, Bharati Vidyapeeth, Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, and YCMOU. With a strong academic foundation and versatile teaching portfolio, Mr. Piyush Shaha is deeply committed to student success, academic excellence, and continuous learning in the domain of statistics and business education.

Name: Dr. Rohit Kumar Sharma
Bio: Dr. Rohit Kumar Sharma is currently working as Associate Professor at School of Business, Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University. Previously he was associated with Centre for Management Studies Dibrugarh University, The Assam Kaziranga University, Amity University Mumbai campus, Adamas University, Kolkata and Christ University Pune Lavasa campus. He has a total of 17 years of teaching and academic administration experience. He has completed his master’s in finance and Ph.D. from Dibrugarh University.
Scopus: He has published 1 book and published many research papers including Scopus indexed research papers and have keen interest in academic administration. He has also headed the Planning and Monitoring Department at Adamas University as Director. His research interest is in the area of Behavioural Finance.

Name: Ms. Shubhi Trivedi
Bio: Ms. Shubhi Trivedi is currently pursuing her Ph.D. from Gujarat National Law University, Gandhinagar. She completed her LL.M. in IPR laws from National Law University Jodhpur.She holds the Proud Achiever Award for the Batch of B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) at Law College Dehradun, Uttaranchal University. Her area of interests includes intellectual property rights law, general principles of contract, constitutional law, law of torts, family law to name a few. Prof. Trivedi has published papers in various areas of law pertaining to protection of sports moves through intellectual property rights, patents and ethics, artificial intelligence copyright and patents and the arbitration and consolidation and others. Apart from academics she also has interest in debating, writing, mooting and dramatics. She has presented several papers in conferences of repute.

Name: Dr. Aarti Renukadas Shastri

As an academic, Dr. Shastri is passionate about teaching and mentoring students. She uses her research work to enrich her teaching and provide real-world examples to students. Her enthusiasm and dedication have earned her the respect and admiration of her students and colleagues.

Name: Dr. Chandrashekhar Himmatrao Patil
Bio: Dr. C. H. Patil received his MCA (Computer Science) in 2006 from University of Pune, Pune and Ph.D.in 2016 from Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University, Pune. Name: Dr. Shilpa Samir Chapadgaonkar
Bio: Dr. Shilpa S. Chapadgaonkar is an experienced academician and researcher with expertise in upstream processing, bioseparation, and enzyme technology. With over 15 years of teaching experience at UG, PG, and PhD levels, she has guided four PhD candidates to completion and is currently supervising three more, along with several M.Sc. and M.Tech. projects. She is leading the Department of Biosciences and Technology at MITWPU as Program Director. She has held key roles such as MSc (Biotech) Program Coordinator, Research Cluster Head, and PhD Program Coordinator, contributing significantly to NAAC and UGC audits. Her research focuses on drug discovery, bioprocess development for biopharmaceuticals, and investigating genetic disorders like infertility and autism. Passionate about sustainability, she has developed technologies for waste valorization, enzyme formulations, and textile wastewater treatment. Dr. Chapadgaonkar’s work has been supported by grants from the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), and she has led industrial collaborations with global companies like BASF and Gennova Biopharmaceuticals. She has published over 40 papers in high-impact journals and authored two textbooks adopted by universities worldwide. Qualification: B.Pharm, M.Sc. Tech (ICT Mumbai), Ph.D. IIT Delhi Experience: 16Y Research: Enzyme Technology, Bioprocess Technology, Subjects Taught Bioprocess Technology, Downstream Processing, Animal Biotechnology, Drug Design, Pharmaceutical Technology, Food Microbiology

Name: Dr. Pooja Pravin Gundewar
Bio: Pooja Gundewar is a highly qualified engineer with extensive experience in the field of Instrumentation Engineering. She graduated from SGGS College of Engineering, Marathwada University in 1992, and went on to complete her master's degree in M.E. (Instrumentation) from Govt. She has published over 34 research papers in various conferences and journals and authored the book “Instrumentation and Control” in Oct 2000. She is highly skilled in industry-oriented projects, and under the Industry-Academia Immersion Program, she worked with Forbes Marshall, Chakan, for three months in 2022. Name: Dr. Manasi Gokhale
Bio: Dr. CA Manasi Gokhale is an Assistant Professor in the area of Finance at the WPU School of Business, MIT World Peace University, Pune. She brings over 20 years of rich experience spanning industry, professional practice, and academia. Prior to her academic career, she worked with a leading financial institution as part of their project finance team. As a Chartered Accountant in full-time practice, she undertook diverse assignments across auditing, taxation, and financial consultancy. Notably, she has also led the end-to-end finance function for a start-up in the software services sector. She has been awarded a PhD in Management (Finance) from Symbiosis International (deemed) University. Her research interests lie in the fields of Corporate Governance, Financial Reporting Frameworks, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), and Sustainability Reporting Practices. She has published her research in indexed journals and continues to contribute actively to these domains. She is also a Fellow Member of The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
Research_Areas: Financial Reporting, Corporate Governance, CSR, and Sustainability reporting Orchid ID 0000-0002-9835-6050

Name: Dr. Deepak Kumar
Bio: "Dr. Deepak Kumar is an accomplished Assistant Professor at the School of Mechanical Engineering, Dr. Vishwanath Karad, MIT World Peace University in Pune, Maharashtra. He is a highly regarded researcher with a passion for the numerical analysis of fluid-structure interactions, refrigeration and air-conditioning, and solar energy. Having earned his PhD in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad, Dr. Kumar's research has resulted in numerous peer-reviewed publications in top-tier international journals and conferences. His innovative and impactful contributions have received recognition and numerous awards. In addition to his research, Dr. Kumar is an active mentor and instructor. He has taught a range of mechanical engineering undergraduate and graduate courses, and has supervised multiple postgraduate students in their research projects. Dr. Kumar is committed to inspiring and guiding the next generation of engineers and researchers in India. To learn more about Dr. Kumar's research interests, publications, and teaching activities, visit his website at https://sites.google.com/view/drkumardeepak/home."
Research_Areas: Vortex-induced Vibrations, Drag reduction and Flow Control, Fluid-Structure Interaction, Thermal management of systems

Name: Dr. Shamim Mohammad
Bio: Dr. Shamim received his first degree in rehabilitation sciences from the National institute of Empowerment of People with Intellectual Disabilities, Secunderbad; MA and M.Phil. degrees from the Indian Universities. He majored in Public Health from Ohio University under International Ford Foundation Fellowship program in 2008; his doctoral work from the Symbiosis International University, Pune in Health Sciences in 2018. He taught 7 years at Umm AL Qura University, Makkah, KSA, 1 year at OP Jindal Global University, Sonipat, Haryana, and presently teaching at MIT WPU, Pune. He has also practiced public health through various agencies government and non-government agencies for the last past 15 years. He has more than a dozen publications in his credit. Furthermore,, he is a licensed from the RCI as a rehab practitioner.

Name: Dr. Santosh Aghav
Bio: Dr Santosh Aghav, has experience of more than 22 years in Academics. Since 1st Oct 2003, he was associated with Symbiosis Law School Symbiosis International (Deemed University) Pune. He has served Director of Symbiosis Law School Hyderabad and contributed in various leadership positions. He was a member of the Academic Council, Board of Studies Faculty of Law SIU and Shri RG Assam University School of law, Public policy and Cooperative Management. He was also a Member, Global Alliance of Justice Education (GAJE) -Global Network, Network Member of Transparency International, International Papers Committee Reviewer Global Science Technology Forum, Singapore, Member -Indian Council of Human Rights. He has presented papers in national international conferences and seminars. Has published papers in various journals. He worked in various spheres of academic and administration as in charge of various degree and diploma programmes, Centre of Excellence and leaded as faculty in charge Community Legal Care Centre catering to justice education, legal services to innovate, facilitate exposure to students and interdisciplinary researchers. Served as faculty in charge of Community Legal Resource Network Programme with City University of New York, USA and SLSP SIU and participated in training for course development under Erasmus Mundus EURASIA Programme with St Kliment Ohradiski, Sofia University, Bulgaria. Participated in various Edu programmes from local to global and urban to rural. Strived by taking steps to develop distinct institutional collaborations with various partners including international resources, training academy for Police, Prison, Government officials to private sector and incubators programme with team. He worked on various Research Projects including Handbook on Indian Penal Code sponsored by Adv Ram Jethmalani. Was the Member on the implementation of the Juvenile Justice Act under the guidance of Hon'ble Justice Madan Lokur, Supreme Court of India. Awarded by Community Justice Welfare, Award in 2015 by Adarsha Mitra Mandal,(Guiness Book of Record Holder for Peace Reading ) Pune Maharashtra. Panelists for Nationwide consultation on Safety of women and child and trafficking organized by Pune Police Commissionerate, The Indian Police Foundation, Bureau of Police Research and Development, Centre for Police Research and Yashda.

Name: Mr. Mandar Bapat
Bio: Mandar Bapat completed B.A. in English and also holds a degree of Master in Personnel Management and Diploma in Labour Law. He is currently working as a full time faculty at MIT World Peace University, Kothrud to teach PEACE Subjects for World Peace University. He has corporate working experience of around 12 years which includes manufacturing as well as Multinational Software Company; He has worked in Admin and HR Department. He is Certified Master NLP – Coach Practitioner from (ICTA), He also Practices Emotional Intelligence and HUNA. (A Hawaiian Method of Healing. He conducts Counselling, Meditation and various Therapy sessions for healing, helps to overcome mild depression and personality development. He has done marital counselling courses and does premarital & marital counselling at his office. He has conducted various soft skills training at manufacturing companies as well as software companies and at PMI as well. He has conducted Personality Development Training at Symbiosis University Lavale Pune Campus for the last four years.

Name: Dr. Puskaraj Devidas Sonawwanay
Bio: Dr. Puskaraj D Sonawwanay is an experienced mechanical engineer, researcher, and educator with over 26 years of experience in the field. He obtained his Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Mechanical Engineering from the Government College of Engineering Pune (COEP), India, where he ranked first in ME Mechanical Design Engineering in the 2000 batch at the University of Pune, India. He received his Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from Savitribai Phule Pune University, India, with several peer-reviewed papers, patents, and book chapters in Springer. Dr. Sonawwanay's research interests include Materials Processing, Mechanical Engineering Design, and Concentrated Solar Energy. He has published 43 research papers and has won several awards for his innovative designs.

Name: Dr. Meenal Kaustubh Pendse
Bio: She is a certified digital marketing professional (IIM Jammu) and has delivered sessions on Personal Branding, the Metaverse, and Green Marketing. Her award- winning work in greenwashing and consumer behavior has been recognized at several international conferences.
Scopus: Dr. Meenal Pendse is an experienced academician with over 17 years of teaching and leadership experience in Marketing. Currently serving as Associate Professor at MIT World Peace University, Pune, she has held key positions including Program Head for Digital Marketing and Marketing Area Chair. With a Ph.D. in Marketing and multiple research publications in Scopus and UGC-listed journals, her expertise spans Services Marketing, Sustainable Marketing, and Digital Strategy.

Name: Dr. Deependra Sharma
Bio: Dr. Deependra Sharma is a visionary academic leader and the Dean of the School of Business at MIT World Peace University, Pune. With a dynamic career spanning over 25 years, he brings a future-focused approach to management education i.e. constantly evolving, refining, and adapting to the needs of an ever-changing global business landscape. An alumnus of the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM-A), Dr. Sharma combines deep academic insight with practical industry experience. His early career in managerial roles across Indian industries shaped his pragmatic approach to education, blending theory with real-world relevance. A strong proponent of global academic exchange, he has contributed to international curriculum development, student mentorship, and partnerships with institutions such as UCLA and the University of Maryland. Dr. Sharma continues to inspire through his editorial work, active conference participation, and mentorship of the next generation of business leaders. His passion for continuous improvement and strategic foresight make him a driving force behind the School of Business’s mission to deliver relevant, world-class education for tomorrow's leaders.
Scopus: Throughout his academic journey, Dr. Sharma has led curriculum transformation, fostered innovation, and championed collaboration between academia and industry. His leadership is rooted in a strong belief in empowering students, not just as learners, but as future entrepreneurs and changemakers. He has played a key role in nurturing a culture of innovation and enterprise, championing incubation initiatives, experiential learning, and industry-aligned pedagogy across his leadership roles. His research areas such as innovation diffusion, entrepreneurship, consumer behaviour, and university–industry partnerships, with publications in leading journals indexed in Scopus, Emerald, and Elsevier.

Name: Mr. Kundan Ramesh Nagare
Bio: Prof. Kundan R. Nagare is an Assistant Professor at MIT-WPU, who completed his post-graduation in Mathematics from SPPU in 2015. In 2016, he cleared the State Eligibility Test (SET) examination and started his teaching career as an Assistant Professor at MIT-WPU in 2017. Prof. Nagare is a dedicated educator with a passion for teaching and has been actively involved in various research projects. In 2022, he was granted a patent for his invention of a "Robotic device to capture marine life samples," which demonstrates his creativity and innovation in the field of robotics.

Name: Dr. Pournima Nilesh Inamdar
Bio: Dr. Pournima N. Inamdar is a distinguished academician and legal professional with over 19 years of experience in teaching, research, and administration. Currently serving as Associate Professor and Associate Dean of External Relations at MIT-WPU School of Law, she has previously held prestigious positions at renowned institutions such as ILS Law College, Symbiosis, and BVDUS New Law College, Pune. Dr. Inamdar is actively involved in academic and professional committees, including roles as Legal Advisor for the Maharashtra Rowing Association, Editor for law and management journals, and member of various institutional bodies at MIT-WPU. Her leadership extends to organizing various events such as International Symposium on Law and Peace, International Women’s Day and serving as a mentor for student initiatives. A recipient of the "Law Teacher of the Year" award from the Indian National Bar Association (2023) and the "Ideal Teacher Award" (2024), Dr. Inamdar is committed to fostering a stimulating learning environment and promoting the growth of her students and institution. Her dedication to education, research, and institutional development makes her a valued member of the MIT-WPU faculty.
Scopus: With a PhD in Law from Nagpur University and an MBA in HR from Pune University, Dr. Inamdar brings a multidisciplinary approach to legal education. Her expertise spans intellectual property rights, constitutional law, and interdisciplinary research, with numerous publications in Scopus-indexed and UGC-approved journals. She has also presented papers at national and international conferences, contributing to discussions on topics like sustainability, gender studies, and technology in education.

Name: Ms. Renuka Deshpande
Bio: Ms. Renuka Deshpande, an architect and designer, is currently an Assistant Professor at the School of Design, MIT World Peace University, specializing in User Experience Design. With over 3 years of combined experience in teaching and practicing design, she brings a multidisciplinary perspective to the classroom. She is deeply passionate about understanding user behavior through the lens of psychology and research, with a strong emphasis on functionality and innovation. Her interests lie in the amalgamation of physical and digital aspects of interaction design, usability, accessibility, and emotional design—all of which guide her pursuit of creating meaningful and inclusive user experiences. Renuka is equally enthusiastic about teaching design, and finds joy in mentoring young minds, encouraging critical thinking, and nurturing a user-first approach in the design process. Name: Mr. Akshay Ugale
Bio: Mr Akshay Ugale has a total experience of 7 years with 5+ years of experience in teaching and 2 years of experience in the public policy and analysis field. Along with engaging students in the classroom he has been mentoring students for various different competitions and social engagement activities creating curious minds which will become good citizens in the future. He has a number of publications in academic journals and books and working towards more publications.

Name: Dr. Mandar Sapre
Bio: Mandar S Sapre holds a Ph.D. in the Application of Optimization Techniques in Mesh Smoothing from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering at Symbiosis International (Deemed University). He received his Master of Technology in CAD/CAM from Symbiosis Institute of Technology and his Bachelor of Engineering in Production Engineering from Mumbai University. Mandar was an Assistant Professor at Symbiosis Institute of Technology for eleven years. Before that, he taught Mathematics at Career Forum Ltd. for six years. Currently, he is working as a Research Assistant Professor at the Institute of Artificial Intelligence, MIT World Peace University, starting in December 2024. His research interests include Engineering Mathematics, Finite Element Analysis, Numerical Methods, Optimization Techniques, Machine Learning, Cohort Intelligence, Hybrid Metaheuristics, Operation Research, Application Development, and Programming. He has 22 publications in peer-reviewed journals, conferences, and chapters. He has so far guided 10 masters and over 90 UG students. He is a regular reviewer of different Elsevier journals. Mandar has also served as session chair for a few international conferences. Apart from academics, Mandar enjoys reading novels and listening to and singing Indian music. He loves to travel and experience different cultures.

Name: Dr. Chandrashekhar Digambarrao Bobade
Bio: Chandrashekhar D Bobade is an Assistant Professor and Research coordinator at the School of Health Science and Technology. He has a total of 10 years of teaching experience and 6 years of research experience. Chandrashekhar secured distinction from his first to final year of B.Pharm and was awarded Sir Ratan Tata's meritorious scholarship from the second year of graduation to the end of post-graduation. He completed his post-graduation education in Pharmaceutics from Shivaji University, Kolhapur in 2008 with the First class and received the best outgoing student of the year award during his masters. Chandrashekhar has received research grants of 1.20 L from BCUD, Savitribai Phule Pune University, and has experience writing DBT, SERB POWER grants. He has published high impact research in journals like Nanoscale and Nanoscale Advances with impact factor 5 and 7.5, respectively, and has 3 patent applications and 14 oral research and development presentations in international conferences at AIIMS, IIT New Delhi. His research area mainly includes surface modifications of Biomaterials, Chronotherapeutics, and polymeric drug delivery systems. Chandrashekhar's team has published nanomaterials that support the growth of 3D cells more effectively than traditional 2D cell culture techniques by simulating the ex vivo tissue milieu using multiple components on a glass substrate. Advanced materials with various physico-chemical properties, such as multiwall carbon nanotubes (CNT), graphene (G), bovine serum albumin (BSA), and iron oxide magnetic nanoparticles, were chemically combined to create 3D nanosubstrates. Chandrashekhar is a passionate advocate of Problem and Project-based learning in his classroom teaching. He is also a columnist for advanced career guidance in pharmacy, National Education Policy 2020, and innovative pedagogy in leading newspapers like Maharashtra Times, Loksatta, etc. Chandrashekhar has delivered invited talks on innovative pedagogy and is actively involved in professional activities for the students' development. He is a lifetime member of the Indian Pharmaceutical Association and Association of Pharmaceutical Teachers in India. Chandrashekhar is voluntarily affiliated with the Indian Pharmaceutical Association Pune branch as Vice President.

Name: Dr. Sudeepta Banerjee

Name: Dr. Namrata Sathe
Scopus: Dr. Namrata Sathe is an Assistant Professor at the Dadasaheb Phalke International Film Institute, MIT-WPU. She holds a PhD in Media Studies from Southern Illinois University, Carbondale. Her book, The Neoliberal Self in Bollywood: Cinema, Popular Culture, and Identity (Intellect Books, 2024), examines the consequences of unbridled expansion of neoliberal values within India through the lens of popular film and culture. Her scholarship has been published in prominent academic journals including Jump Cut, Journal of Cinema and Media Studies, and New Review of Film and Television Studies, as well as in edited collections on Indian cinema and media. She serves as the Assistant Editor for the SCOPUS-listed academic journal Studies in South Asian Film and Media . Her research interests include feminist media studies, queer studies, sexuality studies, and popular culture.

Name: Dr. Mukul Sacchit Godbole
Bio: Dr. Mukul S. Godbole currently serves as an Assistant Professor in the Dept. of Biosciences and Technology, MIT-WPU. Dr. Godbole is a cancer cell biologist. His doctoral work focused on elucidating the mechanism of action of progesterone in human breast cancer. The work performed at ACTREC–TMC identified an intricate genomic network that suppresses breast cancer cell migration and invasion in response to progesterone, independent of progesterone receptor expression. Dr. Godbole has published 11 research articles and reviews in peer-reviewed journals of international repute. Dr. Godbole’s research interests include breast cancer, steroid hormones and receptors, cancer cell biology, metastasis, and microbiomes. Dr. Godbole serves as a Guest Editor for the ‘Cancer and Microbiome’ and ‘Cancer Metastasis: Mechanisms and Treatment’ special issues of Cancer Reports. He is also the Editorial Board Member of Cancer Reports. Further, Dr. Godbole serves as an Early Career Reviewer for the Journal of Biological Chemistry. He also serves as a peer-reviewer for Cancer Reports, Clinical Breast Cancer, BBA–Reviews on Cancer, Experimental Cell Research, Heliyon, npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, Microbial Cell, Cellular Signalling, PLoS One, Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology, Gut Microbes Reports, and STAR Protocols. Moreover, he has previously worked as a Freelance Science Editor with Cactus Communications Pvt. Ltd. for three years and edited 410 manuscripts. Name: Ms. Vaishnavi Andhare
Bio: Ms. Vaishnavi Unmesh Andhare is an Assistant Professor at the School of Law, MIT-World Peace University. She completed her LLM in Corporate and Commercial Laws from West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences (WBNUJS), Kolkata and holds a B.A. LL.B from Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University, Pune. She also has a diploma in Taxation laws. Her additional qualification includes a certificate course from Yale University, USA in American Contract Law. Ms Andhare has served as an Assistant Professor of Law at PES Modern Law College, Pune, where she taught Constitutional Law, Jurisprudence and Alternate Dispute Resolution. She also worked as a Visiting faculty at New Law College, BVDU, Pune where she taught Transfer of Property and Competition Law. Her interests include Constitutional law, International Trade Law, Intellectual Property Law, Property Law, Contract Laws and Jurisprudence. In addition to her academic pursuits, Ms. Andhare has worked with the college placement cell guiding many students to achieve their career goals.

Name: Ms. Garima Chaudhary
Bio: Garima Chaudhary is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Visual Arts at the School of Design, MIT World Peace University (MIT-WPU). She holds Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degrees in Fine Arts from Aligarh Muslim University, reflecting a strong academic foundation. With over two years of experience in Visual Arts education, Garima combines academic rigor with practical expertise. Her professional skills encompass research, drawing, painting, branding, print and digital media, semiotics, and photography, with a particular research interest in photography, art, and design. In her teaching, she integrates creative vision with structured project management, enabling her to mentor students effectively. This approach helps students develop critical thinking and robust art skills, preparing them for diverse creative challenges. Garima’s commitment to both academic excellence and hands-on learning fosters a dynamic and supportive environment for aspiring artists and practitioners.

Name: Dr. Mangesh Vilas Bedekar
Bio: Dr. Mangesh V. Bedekar earned his Ph.D in Computer Science and Engineering from BITS Pilani, India, after completing his graduation from SSGMCE, Shegaon, and obtaining his Masters from BITS Pilani. He currently serves as the Professor & Dean, School of Computer Science & Engineering at MIT-WPU. Dr. Bedekar's research interests are focused on areas such as Web Data Mining, Web Personalization, User Interface Design, User Interface Improvements, Browser Customization, Affective Computing, and Information Visualization. Throughout his career, he has supervised numerous bachelors and masters students and has many national and international publications to his credit. In addition to his academic pursuits, Dr. Bedekar is an outdoors enthusiast and a certified First-Aider who enjoys hiking and trekking regularly.
Research_Areas: Web Data Mining, Personalisation, User Modelling, Human Computer Interaction

Name: Dr. Purna Kumari
Bio: Dr. Purna Kumari, Pechetty working as Assistant Professor, is a committed academician with a Ph.D. from Andhra University and a UGC-NET qualification in Management. With a strong foundation in Human Resource Management and OB, stays actively engaged with evolving trends in human resource management, leadership development, and business innovation. Adopts a learner-centered teaching approach that emphasizes conceptual clarity, critical thinking, and practical application . The Research interests include talent acquisition, AI and digital transformation in Human Resource practices and DEI in workplace. Holds Memberships in Professional Bodies like NHRD and HMA.

Name: Dr. Deepak Popat Hujare
Bio: Prof. Dr. Deepak Hujare is currently working as Professor in School of Mechanical Engineering, Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Pune.He is in the field of teaching since 1998 and having 22 years of teaching experience and 3 years industrial experience. He is dealing with subjects Advanced Mechanical Vibrations, Dynamics of Machinery, NVH and Design Engineering at undergraduated and post graduate level.He has guided more than 25 under graduate academic Projects and almost 8 post graduate academic projects. Education  He has completed his school education in 1989 from a village Nagardeola and Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from Government Polytechnic Jalgaon (Maharashtra) in 1992. Afterwards he has completed his graduation B.E. Mechanical in 1995 with distinction, post graduation M.Tech. Mechanical Enginnering (Machine Design) from V.J.T.I. Mumbai from University of Mumbai in 2006 with distinction and Ph.D. Mechanical Engineering in the field of Mechanical vibrations from College of Engineering Pune, Savitribai Phule Pune University in 2018. Employment  He has started his career as a Graduate Trainee Engineer in 1995 at Kalyani Brakes Limited, Jalgaon. He has also worked there, as a Senior Design/Process Engineer in Design Engineering department. Then he has shifted to teaching profession in 1998 and joined as a Lecturer at SSVPS College of Engineering Dhule. In 2007, he has joined in MIT Pune as a Sr. Lecturer (Selection Grade). In 2008, he has been approved as Assistant Professor and from 2011-2019 he has worked as Associate Professor in the same college. Currently he is working as a Professor in Dr. Vishwanath karad MIT World Peace University.

Name: Dr. Shweta Yogesh Kukade
Bio: Dr. Shweta Kukade is a highly accomplished academician who has achieved numerous milestones in the field of Electronics and Communication Engineering. With over 14 years of experience in teaching and research, she is a highly respected figure in the academic community. In 2022, she received her Ph.D. degree from Pune University, Pune, India, which was the culmination of years of hard work and dedication. As an Assistant Professor at the School of Electronics and Communication Engineering, MITWPU, Pune, India, Dr. Kukade is able to combine her passion for teaching with her love for research. Her research interests are varied and include electronics circuits, mobile communication, Internet of Things, physical layer design, and resource allocation in wireless communication. She has published numerous research papers in prestigious international journals and has presented her work at various national and international conferences. Dr. Kukade is known for her innovative and insightful approach to teaching and research. Her students benefit greatly from her extensive experience and her ability to connect complex concepts to real-world applications. She is a firm believer in the power of education to transform lives and is dedicated to helping her students achieve their academic and professional goals. With her impressive credentials and unwavering commitment to excellence, Dr. Kukade is a true asset to the academic community.

Scopus: Prof. Dr. Ketaki Kulkarni is an esteemed Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering at MIT WPU, Pune. She graduated from Government College of Engineering, Aurangabad in Civil Engineering in the year 2003, and then completed her M.E in Civil-Water Resources Engineering from Government Engineering College, Aurangabad in 2005. She was selected for a research fellowship in Indian Institute of Technology, Mumbai, and was a research associate there until 2007. Prof. Dr. Kulkarni has been associated with MIT since 2007 and has taught a variety of subjects like Basic Civil and Environmental Engineering, Fluid Mechanics I, II, Momentum Transfer, Hydrology and Water Resources Engineering, Dams and Hydraulic Structures. She earned her doctorate in Civil Engineering from Savitribai Phule Pune University, specializing in Hydraulic Engineering under the guidance of Dr. G. A. Hinge. She has published approximately 4 international journals and 8 international conference papers, including a BEST PAPER AWARD. She is a life member of the Indian Society of Hydraulics (ISH) and the Indian Society of Technical Education (ISTE). She is also serving on the editorial board of LARHYSS journal, which is a Scopus-indexed international journal. Additionally, she is a reviewer for Water Science and Technology - Water Supply, a SCIE/WOS journal rated in the Q2 journal category.

Name: Dr. Mithila Arvind Biniwale
Bio: Dr. Mithila has completed Ph.D. from Centre for Media Studies, School of Social Sciences, Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi in 2021. The thesis is titled ‘Documentary Film in India: Critical Articulation, Subjectivity and Site of Resistance’. She earned her M.Phil. (Planning and Development) from IIT Bombay, Powai. Her research interests include Documentary Studies, Documentary Digitality, and Regional Cinema. Her professional experience comprises six years of academic experience and two years of industry work. She has worked on various projects at the Institute of Social and Economic Change (ISEC)- Bangalore, Indian Institute of Technology- Bombay, and Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Mumbai. She worked as a Content Writer at Vedh Content and Communication in Pune and as a freelance artist for radio plays.

Name: Mr. Maisam Ali
Bio: Maisam Ali is an independent filmmaker with expertise in both short and feature films. He is a graduate of the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), majoring in Film Direction. His short films have been exhibited and honoured in France, the United States, the United Arab Emirates, and India. His feature film In Retreat was the first Indian film to be included in the ACID sidebar section at the Cannes Film Festival 2024, marking a 32-year milestone. The film was screened at the Busan International Film Festival, Sao Paulo Film Festival, Galway Film Festival, Moscow International Film Festival, and Mumbai Film Festival, among others. In addition, he has been teaching filmmaking at several institutions in India. He is presently overseeing Direction practices at Dadasaheb International Film School in the position of Assistant Professor.

Name: Dr. Mohit Kant Kaushik
Bio: Dr. Mohit Kant Kaushik is an experienced academician specialising in Marketing and Communication, with over 10 years of teaching and research experience. He holds a Ph.D. in Management and has contributed significantly to curriculum development, academic coordination, and faculty training. Dr. Kaushik’s research interests include consumer behaviour, integrated marketing communication, and digital branding. He is known for his student-centric approach, practical teaching methodology, and commitment to academic excellence.

Name: Mr. Pralhad Atmaram Pesode

He is currently pursuing a PhD from the same university. He completed his postgraduation in Manufacturing Technology from NIT Trichy in Tamilnadu, India and his graduation in Mechanical Engineering from Government College of Engineering Aurangabad in Maharashtra, India. Prof. Pesode specializes in Material Science, Engineering Metallurgy, Advanced Manufacturing Processes, Biomaterials, Surface modification of biomaterials, Biomaterial coating, Composites and Nanocomposites for biomedical applications. He is a life member of several professional bodies, including the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE) and the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE). Prof. Pesode has published more than 19 research papers in various international journals and conferences and has worked for numerous conferences, seminars, and educational workshops.

Name: Dr. Priyanka Kumari
Bio: Dr. Priyanka Kumari is currently working as an Assistant Professor in Department of Mathematics and Statistics, Dr Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Pune. Dr Priyanka Kumari holds a Doctorate in Mathematics (Algebraic Combinatorics) from Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani, where she was supported by CSIR-UGC JRF/SRF. She also qualified SET and GATE exam in 2013. She obtained her master’s and bachelor’s degree from University of Rajasthan, Jaipur. As an Assistant Professor of Mathematics, Dr Kumari's teaching and research interests encompass a diverse array of cutting-edge topics. Her primary focus lies in Algebraic combinatorics, combinatorial designs specially difference sets, Boolean bent function, where she has made significant contributions to the academic community through innovative research and publications in esteemed journals. Name: Dr. Nithya N Kutty
Bio: Dr. Nithya N. Kutty has completed her doctoral study from IIT Kharagpur. Her doctoral study was focused on dynamics of scent volatiles synthesis, storage and emission in flowers of tuberose, a widely cultivated ornamental plant in Asian countries. During her doctoral study (through CSIR JRF/SRF fellowship), she has also carried out collaborative research work in the area of metabolite profiling from plant endophytes, hairy roots of carrots and studied the effect of gamma rays on floral volatiles. She has also presented her research work in several national and international conferences. She pursued her post-graduation (M Tech) in Agricultural biotechnology from IIT Kharagpur and completed her graduation (B Tech Biotechnology) from JNTU Hyderabad. Her research area of interests includes plant specialized metabolism, plant-microbe interactions, plant volatiles and metabolomics. Presently she is teaching basic and applied courses at undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral levels. She is a recognized PhD supervisor of the university. She also mentors students for their research project. Recently, she could secure "DST Young scientist and Technologist" grant under which she is working on vaporization of waste marigold flowers using natural deep eutectic solvents. Dr. Kutty could also complete EMBO lab leadership course with full support from EMBO. She also holds two published Indian patents and one granted patent through her research in the domain of green chemistry. Name: Dr. Sumitra Narayan Motade
Bio: Dr. Sumitra Motade is a highly accomplished professional with 18 years of teaching experience. She holds a Ph.D. from Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU), Pune, under the guidance of Dr. Anju V. Kulkarni. Sumitra has also completed M. Tech (E&TC) with Second University Rank and 9.13 CGPA from Dr. BATU Lonere in 2009 and a bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering from Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathawada University (SRTMU), Nanded in 2002. Sumitra's research interests revolve around IoT, communication, and signal processing. Her research contributions include ten papers in reputed journals and six papers in respected conferences. Under her mentorship, a student group secured the Winner position in the HackMITWPU-2023 competition and the Runner-up position in ""The Inventors Challenge"" competition coordinated by STMicroelectronics, AICTE, and ARM Dec 2022. Additionally, Sumitra offers Corporate Training as a part of consultancy services to Devise Electronics Pvt. Ltd., covering topics such as Communication Protocols, MATLAB, Simulink, State Diagram, and State Flow. Sumitra has a unique teaching style and uses innovative teaching practices like Crossword, Role Play, Poster presentation, Flash Card, Seminar, Millionaire, Peer Assessment, Mindmap, Jigsaw, and more for course delivery. She has taught many courses, including Internet of Things, Analog Communication, Coding Techniques, Digital Signal Processing, Signals and Systems, Digital Electronics, and Microprocessor and Interfacing. Furthermore, Sumitra is a Life member of ISTE - LM 49821 and IETE - M223291. Name: Dr. Vinayak Prabhakar Musale
Bio: Dr. Vinayak Musale is a distinguished academic and researcher with over 15 years of experience in the field of Computer Science and Engineering. He is currently serving as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Engineering and Technology at Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Pune. Dr. Vinayak holds a PhD in Computer Science and Engineering from SGB Amravati University, and he has an extensive teaching portfolio that covers a wide range of subjects including Programming Languages, Operating Systems, Advanced Web Technologies, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, and more. Dr. Vinayak has actively participated in multiple IEEE conferences, serving both as a presenter and a session chair. He is recognised for his ability to engage with the academic community, providing valuable insights and fostering collaborative research. His participation in numerous workshops and faculty development programs underscores his commitment to continuous learning and contribution to the academic community. He is also an inventor with several research patents granted in the areas of IoT, Security and automation, reflecting his practical contributions to technological advancements. In addition to his academic and research pursuits, Dr. Vinayak holds multiple responsibilities, including membership on the SoCSE Board of Studies, B. Tech. CSE (Cybersecurity and Forensics) Program Coordinator, Examination Coordinator, and National Academic Immersion Program Coordinator. Additionally, he is also involved in curriculum development and acts as an advisor for the Cybersecurity Lab. Dr. Vinayak also contributed as a research paper reviewer for various journals and national and international conferences. He has been instrumental in guiding student projects and mentoring teams, notably receiving the Winning Team Mentor Award in the Smart India Hackathon Software Edition Grand Finale.
Scopus: His research interests are deeply rooted in cybersecurity, wireless sensor networks, IoT, machine learning, advanced computing and blockchain techniques. Dr. Vinayak has published over 45 research papers in various national and international conferences and journals, many of which are indexed in Scopus, Web of Science and IEEE Xplore. He has also contributed as a research paper reviewer for several conferences and journals.

Name: Dr. Shweta Devendra Shirolkar

She holds a Ph.D. in Management from Symbiosis International (Deemed University), Pune, with a research focus on Information Systems Adoption and Usage. Her research interests span technology adoption and usage, the sharing economy, collaborative consumption, and technology in education management. She also specializes in Marketing Management, Marketing Research, Business Research, and Research Methodology. Dr. Shirolkar brings over 16 years of professional experience, including 4.5 years in the commercial research industry and 12 years in academia. She has actively contributed to academic discourse through paper presentations at various national and international conferences. Dr. Shirolkar remains committed to advancing knowledge in her fields of interest and contributing to research and innovation in management education. She is also actively contributing to academic administration activities, curriculum development, etc., at Dr Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University
Scopus: Her scholarly work includes publications in Scopus-indexed, ABDC-listed, and UGC-CARE- approved journals. She has also contributed research papers to journals bearing both ISBN and ISSN identifiers. Additionally, she has authored a case study featured in the European Case Centre and ET Cases. She holds two published patents registered with the Government of India. and has also contributed a research paper to a journal bearing both ISBN and ISSN identifiers.

She has presented papers at several national and international conferences, including those hosted by IIMs and leading B-Schools in India. Name: Dr. Tanya Kumar
Scopus: Dr. Tanya Kumar is an Assistant Professor at the School of Business, MIT World Peace University, where she is recognized for her dynamic teaching approach and strong research orientation. With over four years of academic experience in marketing and finance, she brings conceptual clarity, industry relevance, and learner-centric pedagogy into the classroom. Her teaching interests span Marketing Management, Strategic Management, and Consumer Behaviour, with a focus on developing analytical thinking and practical decision-making skills among students. Name: Dr. Prashant Joshi
Bio: Dr. Prashant Joshi is an accomplished researcher and academician in the field of medicinal chemistry, specializing in natural product-based drug discovery. He earned his B. Pharm. from Mahakal Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Ujjain (India) in 2006, followed by an M. Pharm. from the School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, RGPV Bhopal (India) in 2009. In 2018, he obtained his Ph.D. under the supervision of Dr. Sandip B. Bharate at CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine, Jammu (India), through the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), New Delhi, as a CSIR-Senior Research Fellow. Dr. Joshi has held academic positions in pharmaceutical and natural product chemistry departments at various esteemed institutions, including NMIMS Shirpur. Currently, he serves as an Associate Professor at the School of Health Science and Technology, Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Pune, India. His research interests focus on medicinal chemistry and natural products, aiming to discover new therapeutics for multi-drug-resistant (MDR) cancers and bacterial infections. He has an impressive record of 32 research publications and 9 US patents in the field of natural source-based drug discovery.

Name: Dr. Shalaka Patil
Bio: Dr. Shalaka Patil is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Biosciences and Technology, MIT-WPU, Pune. She is a dedicated and passionate researcher with a PhD in Biology from the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Pune, under the supervision of Prof. Kundan Sengupta. She holds university rank 1 for her M.Sc. in microbiology from SPPU. She has qualified CSIR-UGC NET-JRF with AIR 22. Her research area is genome biology and chromosomal instability. Her doctoral work focused on understanding the role of the nuclear envelope in maintaining the genomic stability of cancer cells. After her PhD, she worked as a Senior Project Associate at IISER Pune on a project to develop a cost-effective FISH kit for detecting HER2 amplification in breast cancer patient samples. Later, she joined the CNRS Institute of Human Genetics, Montpellier, France, for her postdoctoral research with Dr. Marcel Mechali. Her post-doctoral work was focused on developing an in vivo system to examine the phase separation of the initiation of DNA replication. Through her work, she aims to contribute to advancements in medical research, particularly developing strategies for the early diagnosis of cancers. Her research work has been published in peer-reviewed journals, highlighting significant findings in genome stability and the impact of chromosomal aberrations on cancer progression.

Bio: Dr. Soma Mishra is an Environmentalist and active in research, writing, and teaching for over 12 years. She holds a Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, an M.Tech. in Environmental Engineering from NIFFT, Ranchi. She also earned her M.Sc.in Environmental Sciences from Sambalpur University and B.Sc. in Environment and Water Management from Ranchi University. She received a DAAD fellowship and worked in the University of applied sciences, Dresden as a Visiting Scientist. She is actively associated with the River Bank Filtration group in India and abroad. She worked on many projects related to Lake/Riverbank filtration which are funded by European Commission. Earlier, she worked as a Climate Scientist and Associate Director with Sustain Labs Paris. She also worked as an Assistant Professor in prestigious institutions like Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda and Marwadi University. Her research’s overarching objective is to ascertain, broaden and develop various dimensions of emerging contaminants in the water systems and their effective removal. She has experience in the degradation and detoxification of complex industrial and municipal wastewater pollutants by bioaugmentation and phytoremediation approaches for sustainable development. She also specializes in the field of use of wastewater for agricultural purposes and the management of solid waste at the organizational level by sustainable approaches. She also gained experience in understanding indoor air pollution and its remedies and other associated problems relevant to climate change. Apart from academics and research, she is passionate about social services and worked for many rural communities to solve the issues related to polluted drinking water. She is a founder of SustainOEarth, through which she works for small scale industries and societies to resolve issues related to water and waste management. She is also associated with organizations that worked in the field of women’s Entrepreneurship development for rural artisans.

Name: Dr. Nilesh Bajad
Bio: Dr. Nilesh Bajad completed his Doctoral degree from the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi, under the Prime Minister’s Research Fellowship (PMRF), India’s most prestigious doctoral fellowship program. He also earned his Master’s degree from IIT (BHU), where he developed a strong foundation in Pharmaceutical Chemistry. His Ph.D. research, titled “Exploring the diagnostic and therapeutic potential of rationally designed and synthesized novel multifunctional ligands for Alzheimer’s disease,” focused on the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of multifunctional small molecules integrating both therapeutic and diagnostic (theranostic) functionalities for Alzheimer’s disease (AD). The work aimed to develop novel agents capable of crossing the blood–brain barrier, detecting amyloid aggregates, and modulating key enzymatic and oxidative pathways implicated in AD pathogenesis. Dr. Bajad possesses experience in organic synthesis, biophysical and biochemical assays, cell-based evaluations, assay development, and animal model studies. His research lies at the interface of medicinal chemistry, drug discovery, and neuroscience, driven by a strong motivation to translate chemical innovations into promising biological and therapeutic outcomes. His research findings have been published in leading journals such as ACS Chemical Neuroscience, Talanta, Bioorganic Chemistry, International Journal of Biological Macromolecules, and European Journal of Medicinal Chemistry, reflecting his significant contributions to neurotherapeutics and medicinal chemistry. His long-term vision focuses on neuroscience-driven drug discovery, integrating chemistry and biology to design innovative theranostic and therapeutic agents for neurodegenerative diseases. Research Interests: Synthetic and Medicinal Chemistry; Drug Discovery and Development; Theranostic Agent Design; Chemical Biology and Mechanism-Based Drug Design; Multi-Target Directed Ligands (MTDLs); Alzheimer’s Disease and Neurotherapeutics. Name: Dr. Aditi Shantanu Jahagirdar
Bio: Dr. Aditi Jahagirdar is a dedicated professional with over 28 years of experience in teaching. She completed her Ph.D. in Electronics and Telecommunication in 2021 and has published over 35 research papers in reputable journals and conferences. With two patents granted, one by India and one by South Africa, she has supervised more than 15 postgraduate projects. Her teaching skills are her main strength and she is always eager to learn and implement new teaching methodologies. Dr. Jahagirdar has been recognized for her excellence in teaching with the 'Best Teacher Award 2013' by MAEER’s Group of Institutions and has received the Best Paper Award at the 2nd Springer International Conference in 2017. Her research interests include computer vision, image processing, and video processing.

Name: Dr. Swati Changdeo Jagdale
Bio: Dr. Swati Jagdale is a highly accomplished academic and researcher in the field of pharmaceutics. She earned her B.Pharm. (1998), M.Pharm. (2000) from Pune University, and Ph.D. (2009) from Shivaji University Kolhapur. Currently, she holds the prestigious position of Professor in the Department of Pharmaceutics at the School of Health Sciences and Technology in Pune. Dr. Jagdale's significant contributions to the field of pharmaceutics are widely recognized, with more than 80 research articles published in reputed national and international journals, along with five authored books and ten book chapters. She holds one Indian patent and two patents from the Republic of South Africa, with an additional five Indian patents currently in process. She has also received funding for her research projects from the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) (Amount 21.36 Lakh) and AICTE-MODROB grant (Rs. 17.22 Lacs), in addition to completing two minor research projects at Savitribai Phule Pune University (4.9 Lakhs). As an experienced guide, Dr. Jagdale has successfully mentored 70 M.Pharm. students and 05 Ph.D. students, with four M.Pharm. and two Ph.D. students currently working on their projects under her guidance. Dr. Jagdale has presented her research work at various national and international conferences and also serves as a member of the Board of Studies under Science and Technology for Faculty of Pharmaceutics at Savitribai Phule Pune University. Her research article on ""Formulation and Evaluation of Gastroretentive Drug Delivery System of Propranolol Hydrochloride"" was one of the top five downloaded articles in AAPS PharmSciTech in 2012. She had also previously served as a member of the Board of Studies for Faculty of Pharmaceutics at the University of Pune from 2011-15. Overall, Dr. Jagdale's expertise, dedication, and research contributions have made her a valuable member of the academic community in pharmaceutics."

Her action research projects, sponsored by prestigious organizations, focus on enhancing India's competitiveness and capacity-building for women entrepreneurs. She has also actively participated in national and international conferences, sharing her insights on regional development and higher education. Name: Dr. Anand J Kulkarni
Bio: Anand J Kulkarni holds a PhD in Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Distributed Optimization from Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, MS in AI from University of Regina, Canada. He worked as Postdoctoral Research Fellow at Odette School of Business, University of Windsor, Canada. Anand is a Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering from the Shivaji University, India and holds a Diploma from Board of Technical Education, Mumbai, India. Since 2021, he is working as Research Professor and Associate Director of the Institute of Artificial Intelligence at the MIT-WPU, Pune, India. His research interests include AI based Nature Inspired optimization algorithms, and self-organizing systems. Name: Dr. Brijesh Kumar
Bio: Dr. Brijesh Kumar is a developmental biologist with extensive research experience in genome engineering, including CRISPR/Cas, animal models (chicken and zebrafish), and Drug/Target Discovery technologies. After completing his master's thesis on developmental metabolomics in chicken embryos at IIT Kanpur, Dr. Kumar obtained his PhD on pancreatic beta cell function and regeneration, mitigating diabetes using a zebrafish model from the Max Planck Institute for Heart and Lung Research, Bad Nauheim, Germany. His work led to the identification of several targets and drugs holding potential for therapeutic interventions. Scholastically, Dr. Kumar was selected for developmental biology training at the Marine Biological Laboratory, Woods Hole, Massachusetts, USA, where he witnessed the Nobel laureates and learnt state-of-the-art molecular tools and techniques from world leaders in the field. For his postdoctoral training in disease modelling for Congenital Disorder of Glycosylation and Heart Failure, he worked at Greenwood Genetic Center, South Carolina, USA, Heidelberg University Hospital, Germany, and Duke University, USA, where he contributed to projects focused on molecular genetics, functional genomics, and prime editing. Dr. Kumar has actively supervised laboratory courses, led journal clubs, and mentored researchers, fostering scientific curiosity and technical excellence. Throughout, Dr. Kumar has presented his research at numerous national and international conferences and won several travel and poster awards. Dr. Kumar's research interests focus on leveraging genome engineering and high- throughput technologies, including omics, to uncover molecular mechanisms underlying disease and develop innovative strategies for therapeutic intervention. Name: Dr. Vijayapandi Pandy
Bio: Associate Prof. Dr. Vijayapandi Pandy is an experienced academician and researcher working in the School of Pharmacy at MIT World Peace University in Pune, Maharashtra, India. He completed his B.Pharm with first-class honors in 1997 and M.Pharm (Pharmacology) with the first rank from SCS College of Pharmacy, Harapanahalli, Karnataka, India, in 2000. Dr. Pandy obtained his Ph.D. in psychopharmacology from the prestigious Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS-Pilani), India. Dr. Pandy's primary research interests are in the psychopharmacological evaluation of psychoactive natural products for novel drug discovery in the treatment of nicotine dependence and withdrawal using animal models. He is a life member of several professional bodies, including the Tamil Nadu Pharmacy Council, Indian Pharmacological Society, Laboratory Animal Scientist's Association (LASA, INDIA), Association of Pharmaceutical Teachers of India (APTI), and Indian Pharmacy Graduate Association. Dr. Pandy has over 20 years of experience in teaching and research, having worked in India, Malaysia, Libya, and Ethiopia. He has published over 65 research and review articles in peer-reviewed journals and is a reviewer for various national and international journals. He has also received research grants such as BKP, UMRG, and HIR-MOHE, Malaysia, and recently completed a research project (CRG/2023/005830/BHS; Sanctioned amount Rs 34 lakhs) as PI from DST-SERB, India in November 2022. He was awarded the Mahatma Gandhi Samman Award from the NRI Welfare Society in Bangkok, Thailand, on 27 May 2017. Dr. Pandy has successfully supervised six Ph.D. and twelve M.Pharm research projects and is currently supervising one Ph.D. and two M.Pharm projects. His expertise and contributions to the field make him a valuable member of the academic and research community."

Name: Dr. Rehan Deshmukh
Bio: Dr. Rehan Deshmukh is a Mentor and Assistant Professor at the Dept. of Biosciences and Technology, MIT WPU. He earned his Ph.D. from BITS Pilani in 2020, bolstered by the ICMR Senior Research Fellowship awarded in 2018. During his postdoctoral tenure at IIT Madras, Dr. Rehan worked on the development of an optical assay for amplification-free detection of SARS-CoV-2 using fiber-optic U-bent probes. Dr. Rehan's research spans electrochemical and optical biosensors, with a focus on pathogen detection, disease diagnostics, nanoelectrochemical/optical applications, and surface modifications for sensors. His scholarly output includes 15 publications, a patent, and three book chapters, with key contributions published in Chemical Society Reviews, Bioresource Technology, and Analyst. In addition to his research, Dr. Rehan serves as a reviewer for prestigious journals like PLOS One, Natural Product Research, and Microbial Cell Factories, etc. He is currently editing a special issue on "Biosensors for Detection of Waterborne Pathogens: Recent Advances and Future Horizons" for Frontiers in Water Journal. Dr. Rehan’s involvement in industry consultancy projects underscores his commitment to turning research into practical solutions. By collaborating with industry partners, he applies his expertise in biosensors and surface chemistry to address real-world challenges. These projects allow him to directly impact industrial processes, enhance product development, and ensure his research drives tangible innovation beyond academia. Dr. Rehan can be reached at rehan.deshmukh@mitwpu.edu.in for research and collaboration.https://rehandeshmukh.wixsite.com/website

Name: Dr. Jehath Syed
Bio: Dr. Jehath Syed is a clinical pharmacist and researcher currently serving as Assistant Professor in the Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences at MIT World Peace University, Pune. Dr. Syed's professional journey includes experience as Clinical Research Coordinator at JSS Hospital, where she coordinated multiple COVID-19 clinical trials. Her notable contributions include developing EldenCare (a comprehensive geriatric care application in collaboration with L&T Technologies), De-Med webpage for identifying potentially inappropriate medications, and "Dose 4 You" dose calculator. Dr. Syed has published over 25 peer-reviewed articles in prestigious international journals. She is an active member of ISPE, ISPOR and Cochrane Collaboration. She also serves as abstract reviewer for international conferences – ICPE, ISPOR, ISOQOL and peer reviewer for journals including American Journal of Health-System Pharmacy and Journal of Medical Internet Research. At MIT-WPU, she coordinates courses in Pharmacy Practice, Pharmacotherapeutics, and Clinical Pharmacy, emphasizing case-based learning and evidence-based practice.

Name: Mr. Amit Liladhar Nehete
Bio: Amit L. Nehete received a B.E. degree in Electrical Engineering from North Maharashtra University, Jalgaon, India and M.Tech. Degree in Electrical Power Systems from Bharti Vidyapeeth (Deemed to be University), College of Engineering, Pune, India. He is currently pursuing PhD degree in Engineering from Bharti Vidyapeeth (Deemed to be University), Pune, India with a focus on developing innovative protection schemes for power systems using non-contact electromagnetic current sensing. With an academic experience of over 13 years, presently, he is currently working at the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT-WPU, Pune, India as an Assistant Professor. He is a research student member of IEEE and a lifetime member of the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE). He has authored several indexed research publications and textbooks in his areas of interest: power system protection, electric vehicles, industrial automation, and energy management. His technical expertise includes MATLAB Simulink and SIEMENS PLCs. He has taught a variety of courses, including PLC and automation, Mechatronics, Smart grid systems, Linux-based Python, Finance and costing. In addition to his teaching-learning responsibilities, he coordinates the MTech eMobility programme and departmental placements. He is actively involved in mentoring students, coordinating industrial collaborations, and promoting interdisciplinary learning. As an executive team member of DIPEX, a prestigious state-level exhibition-cum-competition of working models for engineering and agriculture students of Maharashtra and Goa, he has played a vital role in fostering innovation and entrepreneurship among engineering students at the grassroot level. He has been deputed by the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Maharashtra several times to contribute to this techno-social activity. He is driven by a vision of nation-building through industry-institute-society interaction. Name: Dr. Ashwini Ramkrishana Gawade

Additionally, she has hands-on experience with software like PCP Disso and Design Expert Software. Dr. Gawade's practical experience and knowledge of the latest technologies make her a valuable asset to the academic and industrial sectors.

Name: Mrs. Himangi Tanmay Neve
Bio: Himangi Neve is an Assistant Professor in the Bioengineering Department of Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University in Pune, India. She has a master’s degree in polymer engineering and is now pursuing a PhD in chemical engineering. She has 11 years of combined job experience in industry and academia. Her research focuses on developing more effective and efficient bioconversion technologies for converting agricultural waste into high-value items, as well as evaluating the significance of life cycle assessment in processes ranging from waste collection to product distribution. She has produced over 5 research articles in international journals and 3 book chapters, and has garnered numerous accolades, including two Best Paper awards at international conferences and a runner-up team at the MITWPU Hackathon. She also won a Rs. 3 lakh research grant from MITWPU, as well as Rs. 1 lakh in the Hackathon. Himangi has also completed a number of waste management consulting projects for national and multinational companies. She has also published an Indian patent. In addition to her teaching and research responsibilities, Himangi is the department’s IQAC, Exam, Infrastructure, and Rural Immersion Coordinator.

Name: Ms. Renuka Pohnerkar
Bio: Renuka is a visual artist & designer invested in the intersections of South Asian art history and visual storytelling. Name: Prof. Hossein Martin Fazeli
Bio: Hossein Martin Fazeli is a distinguished Iranian writer, producer, and director who has been an A-list filmmaker in North America for many years and currently serves as a Professor of Practice at Dadasaheb Phalke International Film School. With over two decades of experience in producing, directing, and writing fiction and non-fiction television and films, Fazeli has built an illustrious career marked by his extensive international collaborations across more than a dozen countries. His works have been broadcast globally on leading networks such as CBC, BBC, ARTE, and Canal+, earning 37 international awards and critical acclaim. Fazeli’s films often explore themes of human rights, women’s rights, and minority rights, underscoring his commitment to social justice. He has collaborated with prominent organizations, including the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), the European Commission, and Nonviolence International, contributing to impactful film and television projects and national and regional campaigns. One of his landmark productions, the 2007 documentary “The Tale of Two Nazanins”, spotlighted the plight of a teenage girl imprisoned on death row in Iran. Broadcast on major international networks such as BBC and CNN, the film ignited a global campaign that ultimately saved her life, exemplifying Fazeli’s ability to harness the power of storytelling for change. In 2008, Fazeli was honored by the Sundance Institute, participating in their International Filmmakers Award program. As a sought-after speaker, he has lectured globally on the evolving landscape of film production and conducted workshops at prestigious institutions like Simon Fraser University (Canada), SOAS University of London (UK), Aarhus University (Denmark), and the European Film Academy. In addition to his filmmaking, Fazeli is a celebrated Persian poet, known under the pen name “Naanaam”. Currently, Fazeli is completing three human rights-related films, including “PHOOLAN”, a docu-drama on the life and legacy of India’s Bandit Queen.

Name: Dr. Suman Devadula
Bio: Prof. Dr. Suman Devadula, is a passionate advocate of design-led innovation and its role in advancing sustainability across institutions. With over thirteen years of distinguished experience in the design industry and academia, Dr. Devadula brings exceptional expertise in integrating technology, research, and sustainability by design. Prior to joining MIT-WPU in this stint, Dr. Devadula served as Associate Professor, and in leadership positions like Head of Design and Dep. Director at JAIN School of Design, Media and Creative Arts, Bengaluru and also as Research Co-ordinator for Faculty of Creativity and Design. He led curriculum design, program management, and Outcome-Based Education (OBE) initiatives across several UG, PG and PhD programmes. Earlier to this, he served as the founding Head of School at MIT-WPU School of Design, Pune during 2018-2022. His corporate experience includes working as an Industrial Designer at John Deere Technology Centre India, where he managed global design and engineering projects across the U.S., Europe, and Asia. Prof. Devadula holds a Ph.D. in Sustainability by Design from IISc Bangalore, an M.Des. in Product Design from the Department of Design and Manufacturing (formerly CPDM), IISc Bangalore, a B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering from JNTU Hyderabad, and a Postgraduate Diploma in Re- designing Human Rights from IIHR, New Delhi. He has been recognised on numerous national and international platforms for his impactful contributions to design research, sustainability, and to design education. His students have consistently excelled under his mentorship, securing accolades in prominent design competitions globally. An academic leader, Dr. Devadula has served as Chairperson and Board Member in various academic bodies, contributing to the development of design curriculum at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. His research interests span design, cognition, and sustainability, with over twenty-five articles in reputed journals of direct impact to design education and the human condition in several national and international journals and conferences. He holds several design registrations and published patents, individually and collaboratively.

Name: Dr. Mandar Bopardikar
Bio: Neurodegenerative disorders, characterized by the accumulation of protein aggregates in the human brain, represent a significant threat to human well-being for which no therapeutic treatment is available. Dr. Mandar's research attempts to address this condition by exploring the effect of herbal extracts on protein aggregation. During his doctoral research, he discovered an Ayurvedic extract known as Triphala to be capable of inhibiting the formation of protein aggregates in vitro. Further, the very challenging task of identification of the active ingredient of Triphala was successfully achieved and the mechanistic insights into the inhibition process were obtained. After his PhD, he worked as an industrial R&D scientist on the development of generic equivalent of the following: (a) Peptide hormones involved in controlling blood glucose levels (b) Peptides to treat short bowel syndrome (c) Vitamin supplements. During his short tenure at IISER Berhampur, he was in the pursuit of unravelling the structure and dynamics of complex protein enzymes by NMR spectroscopy. Going ahead, he is interested in targeting three interesting research directions: (i) Investigating the effect of Triphala and its active ingredient on protein aggregate-induced cell death by ex vivo cell toxicity assays. (iii) Studying the phase separation and aggregation behaviour of peptide hormones involved in controlling blood glucose levels. Subjects Taught Chemical Biology

Name: Dr. Vinod Shastri
Bio: Dr. Vinod Shastri has 40 years of diverse experience spanning entrepreneurship, entrepreneurship education, administration, training, teaching, finance, and production, but he is essentially an entrepreneurship educator at heart. Prior to joining MIT-WPU, he served as Dean of Student Affairs and Head of the Centre for Innovation & Entrepreneurship (CIE) at Bennett University, and earlier as Deputy Director at Symbiosis. He successfully built an entrepreneurial culture at both universities. From co-founding a unique start-up to co-authoring the Global Entrepreneurship Monitor (GEM) Report, he belongs to the rare breed of educators who practice what they preach and is widely acknowledged as a culture builder par excellence.

Name: Mr. Abhinay Kamble
Bio: Abhinay Kamble brings together academic depth and creative practice as a filmmaker and media professional, A UGC-NET Qualified with a strong academic foundation in Psychology (B.A.) and Media and Communication Studies (M.Sc. Savitribai Phule Pune University). Specializing in video production, his work spans direction, cinematography, and documentary filmmaking. Abhinay Shot & co-directed Bhutacha Mala, inspired by the writings of Annabhau Sathe, and contributed as a camera assistant to Gana Gondhal, a feature film exploring subaltern art and politics. His latest documentary film project, The Bombay Philatelist, traces the journey of a retired PWD worker whose vast collection of rare postage stamps serves as a testament to cultural preservation. A 2024 fellow of PSBT’s Doc_Commune project, Abhinay’s practice lies at the intersection of creative storytelling and academic inquiry. With expertise in multimedia production, photojournalism, and visual design, he works across diverse mediums to engage with themes of culture, identity, and social consciousness.

Name: Dr. Bharat Sambhu Chaudhari
Bio: Dr. Bharat S. Chaudhari has pursued the BE in Industrial Electronics from Amravati University in 1989 and then METelE and PhD in Engineering from Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India, in 1993 and 2000, respectively. After being a Full Professor in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering with the Pune Institute of Computer Technology and the Dean and Principal of the International Institute of Information Technology, Pune, he joined MIT World Peace University (then MIT Pune) in 2014 as a Professor. Currently, he is working as a Senior Professor (Higher Administrative Group) in Electronics and Communication Engineering and Dean – Research and Development. He held additional responsibilities as Dean of Academics (July 2021 - Sept 2022), Associate Dean - Faculty of Engineering and Technology (Feb 2020 - June 2023), and Head of the School of Electrical/Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (July 2017 - December 2023) at MIT World Peace University. With 35 years of experience in teaching and research, he has authored more than 125 research papers in wireless, telecom, and optical networks and edited several conference proceedings and four books. He has four granted patents, and two patents are in the published stage. Since 2007, Dr. Chaudhari has been appointed as a Visiting Scientist (Simons Associate/Regular Associate) to ICTP, a Tier I research organization of UNESCO established by Nobel Laureate Dr. Abdus Salam in Trieste, Italy. Dr. Chaudhari has successfully executed several research and consultancy projects and accomplished international research collaborations. He has delivered technical talks at various conferences and platforms in different countries. Dr. Chaudhari is a recipient of the 2020 IETE N V Gadadhar Memorial Award for outstanding contribution in fostering research and education, the MAEER Pune’s Ideal Teacher Award 2015, and the Young Scientist Research Grant from the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, in 2003. Dr. Chaudhari is a Fellow of the Maharashtra Academy of Sciences, IETE and IE (I), the Founder Chair of IEEE Pune Section (R-10), and a Senior Member of IEEE. He also chaired the IEEE Communications Society Pune Chapter. He serves as a Program Evaluator of the Engineering Accreditation Commission (EAC) of ABET, United States, for accreditation of computer, communications, and similar engineering programs. He has been part of ABET Teams for onsite accreditation at several U.S. and other foreign Universities. He has also undertaken NAAC accreditation peer team visits to various colleges and Universities in India. He has been on the panel of juries of several prestigious national awards and as a member of multiple committees related to higher education, research, and administration established by various universities/agencies.

Name: Dr. Sharbani Kaushik
Bio: Dr. Sharbani Kaushik is a renowned biotechnology researcher with expertise in bioenergy, bioelectronics, and membrane proteins. She completed her Ph.D. in the School of Energy Science and Engineering from IIT Guwahati. Her work in renewable energy and bioanalytical applications includes pioneering research on microbial fuel cells and biofuel cell biosensing devices. As a postdoctoral researcher at The Ohio State University, USA, she made significant contributions to chemistry and biochemistry, especially in membrane proteins, synthetic biology and drug discovery, resulting in multiple high-impact publications. She has also served as an Assistant Professor at the Regional Institute of Science and Technology in Meghalaya, where she introduced new courses and mentored students in biosensors and biomedical instrumentation. Dr. Kaushik has received numerous accolades, including the Young Scientist Award from the Materials Research Society of India and the ISEES Best PhD Thesis Award from the International Society of Energy Environment and Sustainability.. Her excellent presentations and publications at international conferences reflect her ability to communicate complex scientific concepts effectively. In addition to her research, Dr. Kaushik has held administrative roles, such as Travel Award Co-Chair for the Postdoctoral Association at the Ohio State University and Departmental PhD Representative to the Student Academic Board, IIT Guwahati. Her extensive publications in prestigious journals and book chapters highlight her contributions to sustainable energy and membrane protein biogenesis. Dr. Kaushik remains dedicated to advancing science through her research and education, driving innovations in bioelectrochemical devices and sustainable energy solutions.
