Name: Dr. Sandeep Namdev Dhikale
Bio: Dr. Sandeep Dhikale, also known as Sandeepsagar, embodies a distinctive confluence of the traditional Gurukul system and modern educational paradigms. His academic pursuits span a spectrum of disciplines, including Sanskrit, Peace Studies, Indology, and Meditation. Dr. Sandeep has actively contributed to academia by presenting over 22 research papers at various international, national, and state-level conferences, reflecting his interdisciplinary approach and commitment to scholarly excellence. He is also the author of three acclaimed books: ‘Understanding Peace’; ‘Dimensions of Peace’; ‘Indian Knowledge Systems: A Treasure Trove of the Way of Holistic and Sustainable Life’ These works reflect his deep engagement with the themes of peace, holistic living, and the rich heritage of Indian knowledge traditions. He is currently serving as an Assistant Professor in Peace Studies at the School of Business and Management, MIT World Peace University, Pune.

Name: Dr. Sanjeev Kumar Shangary
Bio: Sanjeev Kumar Shangary, Ph.D., is a Professor in the School of Consciousness at the Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University (MIT-WPU), Pune, India with over 25 years of cumulative experience in academics, research, and industry. He obtained a Master’s degree in Biology (Molecular Biology and Biochemistry) and a Ph.D. degree in Life Sciences, both from the Guru Nanak Dev University (GNDU), Amritsar, India. He received post-doctoral fellowship from the Centre for Cellular & Molecular Biology (CCMB), Hyderabad, India. This was followed by two post-doctoral research associate (RA) positions from the University of Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh, USA, where he, initially, focused his research on understanding and delineating the cell signaling pathways triggered during ionizing radiation-induced DNA damage. Later, he investigated the impact of the synthetic peptides, derived from the Bcl-2 family proteins, on the chemo-resistant leukemia. He, next, joined the University of Michigan Comprehensive Cancer Center, as a research faculty (Research Investigator and later promoted to Research Assistant Professor position), where he played an instrumental role in the discovery and pre-clinical development of a novel class of small-molecule inhibitors targeting the MDM2-p53 interaction for the treatment of cancer. Subsequently, he joined the R&D Oncology division of the Piramal Enterprises Ltd, Mumbai, India as an Assistant Director, and led a team on several cancer drug discovery programs. Prior to joining the MIT-WPU, he was an Associate director and team lead of the Drug Repurposing vertical at the Excelra Knowledge Solutions, Hyderabad, India. He was the recipient of the prestigious Young Investigator Award of the Melanoma Research Alliance (MRA, USA) and a research grant, as Principal Investigator, from the MRA. He also played a role as a co-investigator on the grants funded by the National Institute of Health, USA, and the Leukemia and Lymphoma Society Foundation, USA. He has served as a reviewer for several journals. He is a co-author on over 30 original research articles/reviews/book chapters and co-inventor on several patents.

Bio: Prof Bilolikar has a rich academic and administrative experience of 28 years and is a professor of Operations Management at MIT-WPU. Name: Dr. Samuel Jacob Kuruvilla
Bio: Dr. Samuel Jacob Kuruvilla is an Associate Professor at the WPU School of Liberal Arts. He completed his BA, majoring in Indian History (with minors in Economics & Political Science) from CMS College, Kottayam, followed by an MA in Politics & International Relations from the School of International Relations & Politics, Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam. He pursued his M.Phil in Diplomacy at Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Delhi, and obtained his Ph.D. in Religion & Politics from the University of Exeter, United Kingdom. Previously, he served as a Post-Doctoral Fellow at the School of International Relations and Politics of Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, Kerala. Additionally, he received his Doctorate in Politics and Theology from the University of Exeter in the United Kingdom. Dr. Kuruvilla's research interests primarily focus on West Asian Politics, the Israel-Palestine Conflict, and Indian Foreign Policy. His teaching experience encompasses Political Thought, Theory & International Relations, as well as various Area studies courses at both the Undergraduate & Postgraduate levels. He held the position of Visiting Fellow at the Manohar Parikkar Centre for Defense Studies and Analyses in New Delhi during the period January-April 2012. His life ambition is to write a history of the world from the perspective of the Global South. Dr. Kuruvilla has over 10 years of experience as an Assistant Professor of Political Science at the University of Kerala and over 10 years of separate experience as an M.Phil/Ph.D/Post-Doctoral Researcher in various reputed universities in India & the United Kingdom.

Bio: Dr. Siraj Ahmed Bhatkar is a prominent figure in the field of Petroleum Engineering, currently serving as the Program Director at the Department of Petroleum Engineering at Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University (MIT WPU), Pune. Through his commitment to education, research, and industry collaboration, Dr. Siraj Bhatkar continues to be a pivotal force in shaping the future of Petroleum Engineering at MIT WPU. Name: Dr. Manoj Pralhad Nigadkar
Bio: Dr. Manoj Pralhad Nigadkar is an accomplished academic and social work professional with a strong commitment to teaching, research, and rural development. Currently serving as an Assistant Professor at the School of Business, Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Pune, he brings over 15 years of progressive experience in academia and the development sector. Dr. Nigadkar holds a PhD in Social Work from Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai, along with a Master's in Social Work and a law degree from Shivaji University. His academic journey reflects a vibrant blend of social science and legal studies, underpinned by his ongoing engagement with curriculum development and outreach programs. He has been instrumental in designing and delivering courses on Micro-Finance, Corporate Social Responsibility, Rural Livelihoods, Social Entrepreneurship, and Environmental Governance at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. In his outreach role, Dr. Nigadkar has coordinated multiple national academic and rural immersion programs, facilitating experiential learning for hundreds of students across Maharashtra and beyond. Dr. Nigadkar’s professional experience includes pivotal roles as Associate Professor at the University of Science & Technology, Meghalaya, and executive positions in reputed development organizations such as Tata Steel Rural Development Society and Lupin Foundation. His work encompasses stakeholder engagement, livelihood project implementation, and building the capacities of community-based institutions. Active as a mentor and resource person, Dr. Nigadkar has supervised doctoral and postgraduate research, delivered lectures and sessions nationwide, and contributed to national seminars and conferences. He is fluent in English, Hindi, Odiya, and Marathi, and continues to advance the field through research, teaching, and community engagement.
Scopus: A researcher at heart, Dr. Nigadkar’s scholarship is reflected in numerous publications in Scopus-indexed and refereed journals, covering themes like sustainable development, social exclusion, indigenous rights, and rural livelihoods. He is also a co-inventor on a patent for a Smart Health Prediction System.

Scopus: Dr. Abhaysinha Gunvantrao Shelake is a dedicated Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering at Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University (MITWPU), Pune. With over ten years of teaching experience, he specializes in Construction Engineering and Management. He has completed his B.E. in Civil Engineering and M.E. in Construction and Management from Savitribai Phule Pune University. he earned his Ph.D. in Civil Engineering from Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University (MITWPU), Pune, titled "Development of a comprehensive framework in reducing delays for predictable risks." Dr. Shelake is actively engaged in teaching both undergraduate and postgraduate students. His teaching portfolio includes key subjects like Project Management, Project Scheduling & Material Management, Earned Value Management, Project Risk Management, and Surveying & Geomatics at UG and PG level. His pedagogical approach combines practical knowledge with software applications, making use of advanced tools such as Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil 3D, REVIT, NAVISWORK, Microsoft Project, and Primavera. He is certified by Autodesk and holds credentials including a Six Sigma Green Belt, ISO 9001:2015 QMS Internal Auditor, and a Project Management Professional Plus (PMP+) certification from Simplilearn Academy. Throughout his academic career, he has guided over 24 postgraduate and undergraduate research projects. He has significantly contributed to curriculum development and academic coordination at MITWPU, holding roles such as Academic Coordinator and Website Coordinator. He is a core member of the Board of Studies Sub-Committee and the PMQIC Committee. He has also coordinated numerous national-level immersion programs and industrial visits to premier infrastructure projects, offering students valuable real-world exposure. His research primarily focuses on project risk management, scheduling delays, and the integration of advanced decision-making tools in construction management. His Ph.D. work has led to the development of innovative frameworks to improve delay prediction and mitigation in tunnel construction projects named as IRPAD (Integrated Risk Prioritization for Determination of Activity-wise Delay". He is also actively involved in exploring sustainable construction materials, the application of augmented and virtual reality, and the adoption of Building Information Modeling (BIM) technologies. He has published 18+ research papers in reputed international journals, including SCOPUS- and SCIE- indexed publications, and presented several papers in national and international conferences. Additionally, he has authored eight textbooks tailored for Civil Engineering programs under Savitribai Phule Pune University and Mumbai University. His authored books span topics such as Construction Management, Construction Safety, Smart Building Materials, and Airport & Bridge Engineering. A life member of the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE), Dr. Shelake is committed to academic excellence, research innovation, and mentoring students toward industry-readiness.

Name: Mr. Goutam Bhaskar
Bio: Dr. Goutam Bhaskar is a faculty in the Economics and Public Policy area. He teaches economics and statistics subjects. The primary focus area of his research is energy economics. Specifically, his work is centred on the global push towards renewables to curtail carbon emissions, and the trilemma of affordable energy access for all, energy security, and climate change threats for India he has used advanced econometrics, optimization, and scenario building approaches to analyse the future of power systems in India. In addition to the research work, he has studied and teaches several subjects including macroeconomics, microeconomics, statistics, econometrics, advanced quantitative research methods, and public policy.

Name: Dr. Kanchan Vyankatesh Shende
Bio: Dr. Kanchan V. Shende has completed her Ph.D. in Computer Science from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University, Aurangabad. She worked on “Ocean-Atmospheric Interaction Process over Bay of Bengal during Indian Winter Monsoon season”. She has experience in handling various oceanographic and meteorological data for atmospheric studies using various scientific tools such as Ferret, GRADS, CDO (Climate Data operator), GMT (Generic Mapping Tool) and MATLAB. She also completed M.Phil. in Computer Science and M.Sc. in Information Technology from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University. During M.Phil. she worked on “Crop Area Estimation from Satellite Images using GIS (Geographic Information System)”. She also has experience in handling satellite and GIS data using ENVI and QGIS. Name: Dr. Sanchi Agarwal
Bio: Dr. Sanchi Agarwal is an established researcher and an academician in the field of psychology. Her research focuses on basic human emotion and its role in the social setting. She has published numerous research papers in the social and forensic field. Dr. Agarwal has also played an important role in standardization of two psychological tests on the Indian population. In addition to her research accomplishments, Dr. Agarwal is an active presenter at conferences and symposiums. She is also the recipient of Best Paper awards at two international conferences. Her presentations have been well received and have contributed to the advancement of knowledge in her field. She has been dedicatedly working into academics for more than four years. Her primary areas of interest lie in forensic psychology, inclusive of tools used to measure various aspects. She has also been training students for forensic psychology during the summer internship break. Dr. Agarwal also practices as a psychologist individually. Apart from these, her interest includes school counselling as a research area.

Name: Dr. Parineeta Das
Bio: Dr. Parineeta Das has completed her doctoral study at National Institute of Technology Nagaland (NIT Nagaland). Her doctoral study focused on dendrimers, the emerging polymeric architectures having several interesting features suitable for application in many diverse fields including biomedical field. She has synthesized this polymeric architecture following the green synthetic protocols. It included designing dendritic architectures, green organic synthesis, antimicrobial, biological studies, isotherm study and computational toxicology. During her doctoral study, she has also worked as a Junior Research Fellow on the project entitled “Study of Non-edible Plant-Oils of North-East: Extraction, Compositional Characterization and Analysis for Industrial Applications” funded by North Eastern Council (NEC) in the Dept. of Science and Humanities (Chemistry), National Institute of Technology Nagaland. She has chosen this project because of the alarming concern of alkyd resins from non-renewable resources which have drawbacks such as environmental pollution, depletion of petroleum resources and even a rise in the price of petroleum-based products. In contrary, various plant seed oils are used in the production of polymers due to its renewability, biodegradability, easy availability and its cost-effective properties. The synthesized alkyd resins from the seed oils showed great potential applications in the field of paints, adhesives, coatings, and beneath water marine vessel finish that opposes salt corrosion. She has the experience of water quality survey and detection of various metal ions present in water and its elimination from it. She has given 7 oral and 2 poster presentations related to all her research work at several national and international conferences till date. She has published 5 research papers in peer-reviewed journals and 2 book chapters. She has attended various workshops, short term courses and faculty development programme. She pursued her post-graduation (M. Sc) in Chemistry, specialization in Physical Chemistry from Gauhati University and completed her graduation from Sibsagar Girls’ College, Dibrugarh University. Her research area of interest includes Polymer Science, Biopolymers, Biocatalyst, Dendrimers, Green organic synthesis, Anticorrosive coating, Biodiesel, Computational Toxicology.

Name: Dr. Atanu Hazarika
Bio: Dr. Atanu Hazarika is an Assistant Professor at the School of Business, MIT World Peace University in Pune, India. He is a Post-Doctoral Fellow from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore. The title of the Post Doctoral research is ‘Developing sustainability-related knowledge and capability for farmers, Case Study of an Irrigation Tank project’. The project is sponsored by the Hanns Seidel Stiftung foundation (HSS), Germany. His PhD has been awarded by the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. His doctoral research work has focused on the issues of productivity and efficiency of paddy farming in Assam. His attempts to develop an interdependence (multivariate) framework for measuring the adoption rate of multiple modern technology practices. Additionally, the study attempts to find the technical efficiency and allocative efficiency level of the farmers. In addition, he worked on several projects sponsored by national and international agencies like NOVOD, SANDEE, ICSSR, and NABARD during his PhD tenure. The projects experienced give an exposure to work in different domains like the adoption and expansion behaviour of the Jatropha farmers, the economic valuation of biodiesel, the evaluation of watershed programs, and the financial risk attitude of the handloom micro-entrepreneur. He has worked as a Guest Faculty at Tezpur University, Assam. His teaching interests are Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Development Economics, Operations Research, and Mathematical Economics. His research interests lie in the areas of Economics of Decision Choice, Efficiency and Productivity Analyses, Biofuel, Supply Chain, and Economic Valuation. Teaching Philosophy As an educator, Dr. Hazarika envisages a highly participatory approach to learning and teaching. He is also comfortable collaborating with other faculty and endeavours to create an innovative research environment. https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=7-vyyA0AAAAJ&hl=en SciSpace Profile Link : https://scispace.com/authors/atanu-hazarika-airme5bz84

Her commitment to research and innovation is reflected in two published patents—one on a Holistic Mental Health Management System and another on Sustainable Urban Development. She continues to make meaningful contributions to academia and society through interdisciplinary research and academic leadership. Dr. Muluk remains committed to nurturing future business leaders while advancing impactful, interdisciplinary research in marketing and sustainability.
